comment: The statement “Governance, in this sense, is a policy matter; implementation pattern is not” is too absolute. Implementation topology affects concentration of power, accountability, resilience, security, access, and operational control, all of which are governance concerns.

public.text: The statement “Governance, in this sense, is a policy matter; implementation pattern is not” is too absolute. Implementation topology affects concentration of power, accountability, resilience, security, access, and operational control, all of which are governance concerns.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with something like: “Governance should remain distinct from implementation topology, but the selected topology must be assessed for its governance, accountability, resilience, security, and sovereignty implications.”
